[Log Entry: Day 14 Without CoryXKenshin]

The world has lost its color. Time moves differently now—slower, heavier. Birds no longer sing. I opened YouTube today, hoping... praying… but the “last upload” still reads two weeks ago. My cereal was soggy with despair.

I tried watching other creators, but their laughter feels hollow. Their jumpscares don’t hit the same.

I haven’t seen sunlight. I stepped outside and the wind whispered, “Cory’s still gone…” I’m starting to think the shadows are moving on their own. I swear I saw a sillouette of a hoodie floating past my window, a memory of you and when the world was nicer.

Please, Cory. We need you. The balance is off. The world is crumbling.

Upload… before it’s too late. Before the world collapses for good.

comments.text:
*Logbook Entry*
*Date:* July 5, 2025
*Time:* 03:14 AM
*Location:* HQ Monitor Station – Channel 177 (CoryxKenshin Feed)

---

It’s been *14 days* since the last transmission from Subject CK—**CoryxKenshin**.

No uploads.
No community posts.
No cryptic tweets.
Nothing.

At first, we laughed. “He’s on a break,” we said. “The Shogun always returns.”
But the silence... it’s different this time.

We monitored his usual haunts—YouTube backend activity, Discord pings, shadow TikTok accounts.
*All offline.*
It’s as if he was never there.

At 2:44 AM, the channel banner glitched for approximately *3 seconds.*
A flash of static.
Then an image—barely visible—a silhouette in a tattered hoodie, standing in a doorway. Behind him: red light… and something *moving.*

We ran enhancement protocols. Paused frame by frame.
The silhouette blinked. *Not Cory.*
At least, not anymore.

Some of the junior staff started hearing whispers when watching his older videos. A backwards voice layered behind the outro music:
*"He plays… so they don’t find you."*

I don't know what that means.
I don't want to know what that means.

The last log he left on his private creator dashboard simply read:
*“Don’t wait for me. If they reach you, turn off the screen.”*

We haven’t.
We can’t.

But the screen’s beginning to flicker.
And I think… I think something’s watching from the other side.

*End Log.*
*Pray he returns.*

comments.text:
" H-He'll be back, i swear, its just a joke!! " 

I said that five days ago. The date was July 3rd, 3:15PM EST.. I really thought.. I thought this could be a joke, but i go back to remembering, the shogun doesn't joke. Atleast, not like this. If hes gone for two weeks, he's gone forever. I catch my breath as my heart races in my chest at 85 MPH. It continues. Every single waking hour he hasn't posted, my heart rate begins to increase rapidly. The skies, haven't you seen them too? Since the last time Cory has posted. They've been darker, the 4th of July didn't feel as over exaggerated. You felt it too. I'm not the only one. The monsters. They're scratching at the door has gotten louder than it's supposed to. They're supposed to be QUIET. Cory was keeping them quiet..

Entry two. 

Every single time the door creaks, i hear the scratching. Its now true to me our shogun has kept these monsters at bay, but now, we shall feel their furious wrath. I put my head into my hands, as i suppress a cry, whispering "Cory.. Just come back.. please.. " No answer. My lonely sobs continue, no other sounds, just estranged with the scratches as the monsters at the door try to pry their way in. It hurts with no uploads, and these scratches. They've gotten worse since entry one. Wish me luck, and cory..

Please upload, save us all.

Entry three. 

I lay on the wet ground, now drenched with my tears sweat, and sorrow. My loneliness has now swallowed me. The hopes for a new upload have decreased, the scratching. It just keeps going, it doesnt stop. It wont stop. Not until i see an upload, these monsters will be here until they get what they've been searching for. 

Us.

Yeah y'all ain't getting no entry four so keep thirsting
